Use the SAME robot kinematic reference and its existing yaw reanchoring, not measured car-wheel pose/spin/torque. Parent knee orientation already contains the axle information; this only isolates and increases its task priority. Hold original004 parent,600updates/2048envs/seed42, restored initial PPO scalarLR, mean4 instantaneous normal-load reserve, originalLAST LINK-vz, existing seven-link orientation reward, motor randomization, reference, controller500/10, contact laws and all original gates. Full wheel quaternion/spin tracking remains disabled. Geometry diagnostics are saved-state MuJoCo only; there is no PhysX contact-equivalence, causal or hardware claim. Tightening axle direction may suppress useful camber or drift, so runtime fixtures and unchanged paired behavior evaluation are required before adoption.
